query:
INSERT INTO Files (
                            name,
                            internal_path,
                            size_bytes,
                            mime_type,
                            uploaded_by
                        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                        ON CONFLICT(internal_path) DO UPDATE SET
                            name = excluded.name,
                            size_bytes = excluded.size_bytes,
                            mime_type = excluded.mime_type,
                            is_deleted = 0,
                            deleted_at = NULL,
                            uploaded_at = CASE
                                WHEN Files.is_deleted = 1 THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                                ELSE Files.uploaded_at
                            END
